description: arXiv:2603.02069v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study scaling laws of signSGD under a power-law random features (PLRF) model that accounts for both feature and target decay. We analyze the population risk of a linear model trained with one-pass signSGD on Gaussian-sketched features.
